verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents ring groups that ring in order or all at once, and never documents a built-in fallback that sends unanswered calls to voicemail or another number. What it does show is adjacent: IVR keypad routing, Queue Callback, and developer tutorials for building your own smart-routing or overflow systems. Developer building blocks and adjacent routing features earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can ring a group in order or simultaneously, and route unanswered calls to voicemail or another number
